rules.label: A bachelor's in Informatik (TU Darmstadt's B.Sc. Informatik or an equivalent degree)

check.note: TU Darmstadt decides whether your degree is equivalent to its B.Sc. Informatik (R08). The equivalence decision is separate from the entrance exam result.

citations.quote: A degree B.Sc. Informatik of TU Darmstadt (reference programme), or an equivalent degree.

rules.label: A bachelor's degree of at least 180 ECTS credits (or an equivalent workload)

children.note: Your credits are not in ECTS. The page accepts 'an equivalent workload'; TU Darmstadt decides whether yours equals 180 ECTS.

citations.quote: Bachelor’s degree comprising at least 180 ECTS (or an equivalent workload)

rules.label: At least 60 ECTS of your courses match the core courses of the B.Sc. Informatik (your own count; partial overlaps count proportionally)

citations.quote: Minimum 60 ECTS must match the core courses of our B.Sc. Informatik in content, academic level, and depth
partial overlaps are to be counted proportionally

rules.label: TU Darmstadt confirms that your courses match its core courses in content, level and depth

check.note: Your 60-ECTS count is a self-assessment. TU Darmstadt makes the official content-related evaluation and gives no individual pre-assessment.

citations.quote: We do not offer individual pre-assessments of eligibility
in content, academic level, and depth

rules.label: Entrance exam, only if your documents do not confirm the required competencies: a GRE (verbal 155, quantitative 165, writing 3.5, all in one sitting) or GATE 750 exempts you

children.note: TU Darmstadt decides from your documents whether you must sit the 90-minute on-site entrance exam, and what the result is. A GATE overall score of 750 also exempts, but the profile has no GATE score and no exam-result fact yet (ENGINE-GAP). Even with qualifying scores, ask the university if it still invites you.

citations.quote: If the required entrance competencies cannot be verified based on the submitted application documents, applicants will be required to take a 90-minute written Entrance Exam held on campus at TU Darmstadt
Submission of valid GRE or GATE scores meeting the specified thresholds may qualify applicants for exemption from the Entrance Exam.
Verbal Reasoning ≥ 155 Quantitative Reasoning ≥ 165 Analytical Writing ≥ 3.5
The required minimum scores are binding – there are no exceptions. Missing points in one category cannot be compensated by higher scores in another.

rules.label: Proof of English: IELTS 7.0, TOEFL iBT 95, or official confirmation that your whole bachelor's was taught in English; TU Darmstadt decides on any other proof

children.note: The admission guide lists only IELTS, TOEFL iBT and English-taught bachelor's study; TU Darmstadt decides whether any other proof of English counts.

citations.quote: Or an official confirmation that English was the language of instruction for your entire Bachelor’s programme
